note: Korea's largest banks (KB Kookmin, Shinhan, Hana, Woori) issue their credit cards through their card companies (KB국민카드, 신한카드, 하나카드, 우리카드). Shinhan Card's and Hana Card's sites serve only a script shell to this research, and Woori Card's didn't answer (2026-10-30), so KB Kookmin Card is written, with BC Card's card this file has held since 2026-10-29. KB Kookmin Card's credit card list (read 2026-10-30) shows each card's annual fee by version; the eleven cards the page shows without a script are written, each at its domestic version's fee, or where it has none at the lowest version listed (ALL point 카드 15,000 won, its Visa version 20,000; The Easy카드 15,000). The cards the page loads only by script aren't written. KB Kookmin Card's product rate disclosure (상품별 수수료율, changed 3 February 2026, read 2026-10-30) gives every card the same ranges, each holder priced within them: revolving (일부결제금액이월약정) 5.60% to 19.95% a year, cash advances (단기카드대출) 5.90% to 19.95%, and the late rate on a lump-sum purchase (연체이자율, 일시불) 5.90% to 19.95%, written as the penalty rate (on a cash advance it's 6.90% to 20.00%, not written). Instalment rates and the card loan aren't written. Neither page states a minimum payment, grace period, foreign-transaction fee or late fee, and they aren't written. BC Card's product description for its 신세계 BC 바로 아시아나 플러스 (its file dated 1 July 2025, read 2026-10-29): an annual fee of 10,000 won (a 0 basic fee plus 10,000 for the partner's services), and revolving at 5.9% to 19.9% a year, now written as that range; its file didn't answer on 2026-10-30 and is kept as read.
